methodologyNotes: Covers standalone hardware synthesizers (keyboard, desktop, and rack/module formats) sold new at a published US MSRP. Excludes software/plugin instruments, MIDI controllers with no internal sound engine, drum machines and grooveboxes with no playable synth voice, and Eurorack modules. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. synthesisType is the primary sound-generation method as stated by the maker (enum: analog, virtual-analog, subtractive-digital, fm, wavetable, phase-distortion, sample-based, hybrid). polyphonyVoices is the maximum simultaneous voices (integer; 1 = monophonic, paraphonic engines counted by independent voices). oscillatorsPerVoice is the number of primary tone oscillators or FM operators per voice (integer). keyCount is the number of physical keys on the keybed (integer; 0 = desktop or rack module with no keyboard). keybedType is the key mechanism (enum: mini, synth-action, semi-weighted, weighted-hammer, none). multitimbralParts is the count of independently addressable sound parts playable at once (integer; 1 = single-timbral). patchMemory is the number of user/preset patch storage slots (integer; 0 = no onboard memory). sequencerSteps is the maximum step count of the built-in step sequencer (integer; 0 = no onboard sequencer). arpeggiator is true if a built-in arpeggiator is present (boolean). onboardEffects is true if a built-in effects/FX processor is present (boolean). cvGateIo is true if analog CV/Gate connectivity (in or out) is provided (boolean). weightKg is unit weight in kilograms.

products.name: Moog Muse
products.priceNote: US MSRP $3,499. Kraft Music (authorized Moog dealer) lists the price verbatim as "$3,499.00"; corroborated by Synthtopia's official specs & pricing launch article (July 31, 2024): "The Moog Muse is now available, priced at $3,499 USD." Vintage King also lists $3,499.00.
products.provenance: The official Moog Music product page (moogmusic.com/synthesizers/muse/) confirms the exact model identity as the Moog "Muse" (page title "Muse | Moog Music") but is JS-rendered and exposed no spec text when fetched. Kraft Music, an authorized Moog dealer, carries the full manufacturer spec table verbatim — Analog engine, 8 voices of polyphony, 2 oscillators per voice, 61 full-size semi-weighted Fatar keys, 2 bi-timbral parts, 256 patch storage locations, 64-step sequencer, an advanced arpeggiator, Diffusion Delay effects, and dual 1/8" CV inputs/outputs — and lists the US price verbatim as "$3,499.00", matching the official $3,499 USD MSRP reported in Synthtopia's dated (July 31, 2024) launch article and Amazon's spec table. Weight is given only in pounds ("32 lb"), so weightKg is left null rather than converted; there is a single Muse model with no capacity/variant, so identity is unambiguous.

products.name: Sequential Prophet-6
products.priceNote: US retail price of $3,499.99 listed verbatim on the Guitar Center product page for the "Sequential Prophet-6 6-Voice Polyphonic Analog Synthesizer" (49-key keyboard version). Sequential's own product page does not publish a price.
products.provenance: Sequential's official Prophet-6 product page confirms the model identity and specs: a 6-voice polyphonic analog synthesizer with two discrete VCOs per voice, a full-sized semi-weighted 4-octave / 49-key Fatar keyboard, dual analog distortion + 24-bit digital effects, a polyphonic step sequencer of up to 64 steps, 500 user and 500 factory programs, and a stated keyboard weight of 20.0 lbs (9.5 kg); its I/O list shows only expression-pedal/footswitch inputs, MIDI and USB, so cvGateIo is false. The Guitar Center listing corroborates the exact model (49-key, semi-weighted, 6-voice, same synthesis/sequencer/effects features) and supplies the verbatim US price of $3,499.99, while the Amazon page further confirms identity via model number DSI-2600 and 49-key. Every spec value and the price were taken verbatim from these fetched pages; no release year was stated on either source, so releaseDate is null.

products.name: Korg Minilogue XD
products.priceNote: US price from the Guitar Center product page (corroboration URL): regular/list price shown verbatim as "$799.99", currently discounted to "$699.99" on a demo unit ("Save: $100.00 (13 %)"). The $799.99 non-demo regular price is used as the typical US figure. Neither Korg official page (product or specifications) publishes a price.
products.provenance: The Korg USA official specifications page confirms this is the minilogue xd keyboard model: 37-keys (Slim-key, velocity sensitive), Maximum Polyphony of 4 voices, a "2VCO + MULTI ENGINE" analog/digital hybrid voice (the multi-engine described as "a third oscillator in addition to the two analog VCOs"), 500 programs, a 16-step polyphonic sequencer, ARP arpeggiator, digital effects, two CV IN jacks (CV/Gate mode), and a 2.8 kg weight — distinguishing it from the keyless minilogue xd module and the original minilogue. Guitar Center's product page corroborates every spec verbatim ("37 slim keys with velocity sensitivity", "4-voice polyphony", "2VCO + MULTI ENGINE ... a third oscillator", "500 voices", "16-step polyphonic sequencer", "Built-in digital stereo effects", "CV input") and is the only source with a price. Neither Korg page lists a price, so Guitar Center's regular figure of $799.99 (demo unit currently $699.99) is used as the typical US price.

products.name: Roland Juno-X
products.priceNote: US $2099.99 as listed in the Sound On Sound hands-on review (published October 2022) Information box, attributed to www.roland.com (Roland US price at review time). Roland's own US spec page does not publish a price; the GBP-only Thomann listing (£1,419) was not used for USD.
products.provenance: The Roland US specifications page confirms the exact model — JUNO-X, a 61-key (channel aftertouch) programmable polyphonic synthesizer on the ZEN-Core engine — and states verbatim: weight 11.6 kg, 5 parts (Play part: 4, Rhythm part: 1), 256 user tones and 256 Scenes, an arpeggiator (I-Arpeggio) and full multi-effects/EQ/reverb/chorus/delay complement, and a complete connector list with no CV/Gate jacks (so cvGateIo=false). synthesisType is set to hybrid because the same page states both virtual-analog modeling of the JUNO-60/106 and 900+ PCM-based presets from the XV-5080 plus RD pianos. The Sound On Sound review (published October 2022) corroborates the model and supplies the US price of $2099.99 (Information box, attributed to www.roland.com) and confirms the "single-oscillator-per-voice architecture" (oscillatorsPerVoice=1). Neither cited page discloses maximum polyphony — SOS explicitly notes Roland declines to state it — so polyphonyVoices is null; keybedType is null because sources conflict (SOS "unweighted," Thomann "slightly weighted," Roland silent); releaseDate is the year of the contemporaneous SOS hands-on review of the shipping product.

products.name: Arturia MiniFreak
products.priceNote: Arturia's official MiniFreak product page lists the price verbatim as "649$" next to the Buy Now button, taken as US MSRP/typical price. Thomann UK lists £479 (GBP), which was not used for the USD figure.
products.provenance: The Arturia official MiniFreak overview page confirms the exact model — a "6-voice polyphonic hybrid synthesizer" with a "37-note velocity-sensitive Slim-key keybed with aftertouch," "2 sound Engines" per voice, a "64-step sequencer," 3 FX slots, and "Weight (kg): 2.94 kg" — and lists the price as "649$" (Buy Now). The Thomann UK listing corroborates the identical unit (37 velocity-sensitive slim keys, 6-voice polyphonic, two digital sound engines per voice, step sequencer with 64 steps, weight 2.94 kg) and dates availability to "November 2022." Both pages enumerate full I/O (MIDI in/out/thru, USB, analog clock in/out with reset, sustain, audio in, balanced stereo out) with no CV/Gate; neither describes the 25-key MicroFreak nor the MiniFreak Vocoder variant. patchMemory was left null because the two sources disagree on the count (Arturia: 420 factory / 244 user; Thomann: 320 factory / 256 user), and multitimbralParts was left null as neither page states a part count.

products.provenance: The official UDO Audio product page confirms this exact model — the Super 6, a 12-voice polyphonic binaural analog-hybrid synthesizer with a 49-key Fatar keyboard, two FPGA oscillators, a multi-mode arpeggiator plus step sequencer, dual stereo 24-bit effects and 128 rewritable patches.
